description: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of factual errors across different question-answering systems, namely HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, Musique, and IIRC, when evaluated with three different quality assurance (QA) methods: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40. Each QA method is represented by a distinct color: NoR QA is yellow, OneR QA is red, and IRCoT QA is blue. The horizontal axis lists the four QA systems. The chart shows that HotpotQA has the lowest number of errors for NoR QA and IRCoT QA, with 10 and 5 errors respectively, while it has the highest for OneR QA with 29 errors. 2WikiMQA has 23 errors for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 27 for IRCoT QA. Musique has 28 errors for NoR QA, 23 for OneR QA, and 27 for IRCoT QA. IIRC has 15 errors for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 11 for IRCoT QA. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
